challengeRules: Defeat a real opponent while using one full set of Rock-shell, Spined, or Skeletal armor.
Wear at least two pieces from each of the other two armor sets.
Use an obsidian melee weapon, obsidian staff, and obsidian thrown weapon.
Damage the opponent with melee, ranged, and magic using only obsidian weapons.
The opponent must either be a legitimate PKer or have a loot key worth at least 500k.
All challenge requirements must be observed by participating players when completed in a multi-combat area.
challenges.disclaimer: *Reward items are not removed from the roulette after being unlocked, so duplicate hits are possible and you will probably need more than 12 challenge completions.

challengeRules: Defeat a real opponent while using Dragon mace(bh) as your only spec weapon.
The opponent must either be a legitimate pker or have a key worth at least 500k
The killing blow on your opponent must be a max hit and have the special max hitsplat.
Defeating 3 opponents in this manner completes the challenge.
Defeat a real opponent while using any item that causes fire damage.
The opponent must either be a legitimate pker or have a key worth at least 500k
The killing blow on your opponent must be fire damage.
Defeating 2 opponents in this manner completes the challenge.

completionSteps.name: Acquire Dragon longsword from zombie pirates

challengeRules: Acquire a Dragon longsword from zombie pirates to begin the challenge.
Then defeat 5 real opponents with the Dragon longsword, Dragon sword, Dragon mace, and Dragon dagger in order.
Each opponent must either be a legitimate PKer or have a loot key worth at least 500k.
The killing blow must be dealt with the weapon for the current stage.
Completing all weapon stages unlocks the Dragon warhammer.
Record one completion for each successful skull trick.
Each successfully skull-tricked item may be manually unlocked in the Collection tab as long as it was not an obvious donation.
Each recorded skull trick awards 10 PKP.
Items from obvious donations and +1 smites are given away on stream instead of being kept or unlocked.
challenges.disclaimer: Item unlocks are manual for now. Use the Collection tab to unlock a qualifying skull-tricked item.

challengeRules: Defeat real opponents with full granite and granite maul or granite longsword.
The opponents must either be legitimate pkers or have keys worth at least 500k.
The killing blow on your opponent must be a spec from either granite weapon.
Defeating 3 opponents in this manner completes the challenge.
challenges.disclaimer: Using a granite longsword requires the use of the granite shield.

challengeRules: Defeat real opponents with each of the spec weapons listed.
The opponents must either be legitimate pkers or have keys worth at least 500k.
The killing blow on your opponent must a spec from the weapons listed.
Defeating at least one opponent with each of the weapons listed completes the channelge.
